title: Policy contracts
description: The core policy AST (06 §21; 21 §3.2, §4 Policy; 14 §R3A). Typed, pure and fail-closed: an unknown operator is invalid.

QuestState.description: Persisted QuestInstance lifecycle state (06 §1). Availability is derived, not a state.

Policy.description: A pure condition tree (06 §21). all/any/not compose; the leaves are the 06 §21 operators the R6P proof uses (pre-release-proof.md) and the rest are added with their first use, each versioned by its owning capability, which the cartridge must lock (capability_registry.json policies); adding an operator to a capability version that is already installed takes that capability's next version. A changed meaning of an existing operator takes its owning capability's next version. fact_compare compares FactValue. stat_compare and resource_compare (attribute@1, 06 §21 amendment 2026-10-03) hold when the actor's attribute value, or the current value of the resource on the actor's body, is at least at_least; below is not, a range is all.

oneOf.description: Every item holds; an empty list is the policy with no condition.

items.description: The policies that must all hold.

oneOf.description: At least one item holds.

items.description: The policies of which one must hold.

oneOf.description: The item does not hold.

item.description: The policy that must not hold.

oneOf.description: The resolved target is present to the actor.
The actor holds an item of this definition, directly or inside containers it holds, transitively.
The actor's instance of the quest is in this lifecycle state.

The fact, in the actor's scope, equals this value. An entity or pair fact (toolbox row W2) is read at exactly one subject: npc or item, that definition's authored instance, or subject target, the action's target (false without one); a player or instance fact names none.

with.description: Toolbox row FD4: an npc_pair fact's second NPC, read at the pair (subject toward with).

oneOf.description: 06 §21 time_window, a window of authored calendar hours: floor(time / calendar.units_per_hour) mod calendar.hours_per_day is in `from` inclusive to `to` exclusive, wrapping at day end. The compiler rejects endpoints outside the authored day and equal endpoints (EMPTY_TIME_WINDOW). Owned by schedule@1.

to.description: End hour, exclusive; the window wraps at day end.

oneOf.description: The barrier's current state equals `equals` (room.schema.json BarrierState; closed means closed and unlocked). Owned by barrier@1.
The actor's value of the attribute (cartridge.schema.json AttributeSpec: its start, while nothing writes attributes) is at least at_least. Owned by attribute@1.
Toolbox row 29a: the actor's level (toolbox row 4, derived from its experience; 1 in a cartridge without world.levelling) is at least at_least. Owned by attribute@1.

The current value of the resource on the actor's body (regenerated to now, before the action's costs) is at least at_least; false for an actor without a body. Toolbox row 39: subject subject reads the pool on a reaction's event subject (the actor's body outside a reaction); at_least_percent holds when value * 100 >= percent * the entity's maximum. Exactly one of at_least and at_least_percent. Owned by attribute@1.

subject.description: `subject` reads the pool on a reaction's event subject.

at_least_percent.description: The least percent of the pool's maximum that holds.

oneOf.description: API1.11 escort@1: this actor’s typed escort for the named quest instance has this status.

The subject's definition declares the tag (entity.schema.json Tag). Exactly one subject: subject target, the action's target, holding when it is an item whose definition declares the tag (false without a target, for a detail or for an NPC); subject room, the actor's current room; or item, barrier or room, that definition of this cartridge, a constant (tags never change). Owned by tag@1 (toolbox row G1).

The derived sky at the committed clock, never stored (toolbox rows 10 and 31): exactly one of lunar, season or tide (the cut of that calendar cycle containing ((clock - origin) mod period)) or weather (the calendar day's weather table entry) holds when the current phase is that phase; a set of phases is an any of sky leaves. The compiler rejects a phase the named calendar table does not author, or no such table (SCHEMA_VIOLATION). Owned by calendar@1.
The actor's body wears an item whose definition declares tag (toolbox row W25): an item in one of the body's slot holders (equipment@1). False without a body. Owned by equipment@1.

tag.description: The tag a worn item declares.

oneOf.description: The actor's count of accepted body entries into the room, the current one included, is at least at_least (toolbox row W7): a new character's start room counts once, any other room 0 until entered. Counted only while alternates@1 is locked (VisitedRoom.count). Owned by alternates@1.

at_least.description: The least entry count that holds.

oneOf.description: The actor's level in the named skill (skill@1: 1 when acquired, plus each growth threshold its use count has reached; 0 when neither) is at least at_least (toolbox row FD2). Derived on read. Owned by skill@1.

The named population plan has at least at_least living members: slots 1 to cap whose row has a member_id and no replacement_due (toolbox row W12). Derived on read; reads no actor. Owned by population@1.

at_least.description: The least living count that holds.

oneOf.description: The subject holds an active status of this definition (status@1 row; toolbox row W6). subject target: the action's target, or, in an entity's own variant (TextVariants), the entity described; false without a target or for a detail. subject self (toolbox row G3 reader 1): the actor's body. subject subject (reader 1): in a reaction's when, the event's subject, the holder a status.apply without item, npc or co_present lands on; false anywhere else. subject room (Built rooms S4, status reader 9): the actor's current room, which is the room being described in a room's or structure's variant. Owned by status@1.

An item carrying this property tag (Tag, toolbox row G1) lies directly in the actor's current room: on its floor, not carried and not inside a container there (Homestead hs-6, furnishing). That is the actor's room (the only room the Book describes), as status_active subject room; in a reaction's when the reaction's actor's room. One query step per container row scanned. Owned by containment@1.

tag.description: The tag of an item on the floor.

oneOf.description: The NPC of this definition is present: in the actor's current room and alive (hp above 0 when it has hp); false without a body. Presence, not posture (the player's posture is the position fact). Toolbox row W6. Owned by target_resolution@1.

The NPC of this definition, alive, perceives a cue of sense (toolbox row G6): an active Cue whose source is within its range of the NPC's room, through exits not hidden from the actor, read for the actor (a reaction's actor); in a reaction's condition whose cause is a scripted action outcome event (check_failed: failure; check_passed or action_completed: success), only that outcome's cues, from the actor's room. False for an NPC that is dead or nowhere. Owned by sense_cue@1.
Toolbox row FD1: the world clock minus the int fact's value (as fact_compare reads it, at its named NPC or item) is at least at_least; a fact never stamped holds its default. Owned by fact@1.

fact.description: The int fact holding a stamp.

at_least.description: The least elapsed time that holds.
